messages.content: I think I've been treating my own goals as less important than everyone else's needs.
Honestly, that's a genuinely common pattern, especially for people who see themselves as the reliable one. What made you notice it this time?
I keep pushing my own project back to help other people with theirs.
That's honestly worth examining closely - helping is good, but consistently deprioritizing yourself isn't sustainable generosity, it's more like self-neglect.
I think I'm scared people will think I'm selfish if I say no sometimes.
That fear makes sense, honestly, but genuinely reliable people also protect their own time - it's not selfish, it's actually what makes the help you do give sustainable.
